description: Experiment A, SPARK half (baseline at minimum EMR capacity). Runs the Spark graph construction and analytics stage at the session 2 build commit on INPUTS REUSED from Phase 14 (planned deviation 3): the J09 export run=ce46078e05b80d2d5e119939b7d04306 (Phase 14 D6 attempt 4, 20261119T005309Z-f159535e498a-2fcc) and the ER identity assignments of run:v1:23b913cc4dab1155d7a75c505eff5d56 (ER attempt 20261119T020635Z-f159535e498a-5bd1), into its own new out-root graph/runs-p15-a/ATTEMPT_ID, no export. Settings: managed-scaling maximum 2 core units (= minimum, flat capacity), spark.sql.shuffle.partitions 32 (today's value). Records records out per table, tasks, stages and shuffle per stage group, stage durations, failures, estimated cost and the EMR capacity series. Compared ONLY with p15-b-spark-burst (same inputs and code; partitions 32 vs 128, maximum 2 vs 4 core units); never with the Hadoop half and never as a total pipeline duration.
datasetSnapshot: dblp-2026-11-01 (DBLP XML with dblp.dtd), subset rule dblp-subset-v1 (datasets/dataset-manifest.yaml); Spark inputs reused from Phase 14 (J09 run=ce46078e05b80d2d5e119939b7d04306, ER run=23b913cc4dab1155d7a75c505eff5d56)

resourceLimits.emrUnitType: Instances (core nodes; the primary node is outside the limits)
resourceLimits.terraformSource: infra/terraform/environments/course/variables.tf (emr_managed_scaling_min_units 2, emr_managed_scaling_max_units 4); execution-input fields cluster.managedScalingMaxUnits and spark.shufflePartitions (8..512) resolved and bounded in state ReadInput (infra/terraform/modules/workflow/sfn.tf); infra/terraform/modules/workflow/variables.tf (pipeline_timeout_seconds 14400); infra/terraform/modules/emr/variables.tf (idle_timeout_seconds)

notes: APPROVAL: the human signs this exact file at D9 with the line APPROVED-MANIFEST-SHA256: HEX64 in docs/agent-runs/phase-15/approvals.md; any change is a new sha256 and a new approval. A retry is a new attempt of the same manifest: {attempt-id} gives it a fresh out-root (G-21: a rerun into the same out-root is refused). Runs at D11a beside C and D (concurrency invariant). COST (estimate): expected about $0.65 = about 50 min (Phase 14 D8 attempt 2 took 32.5 min while its core nodes rose to 4 from minute 8; at 2 core nodes longer; estimate) x 3 m5.xlarge x $0.24 per instance-hour (COSTS.md EMR row, estimate); costBoundUsd 1.5 is about twice that; upper bound from the remote limits (state machine 14,400 s + idle end 900 s at 3 instances) about $3.10 (estimate). DURATION: maxDurationSeconds 17,400 = --wait-timeout 14,700 + cluster end wait 900 + 1,800 margin. METRICS: every EMR query above seen in account (aws-api list-metrics, Phase 14 cluster j-07168191925RA7C2EGJU, 6b); TotalUnits*/CoreUnits* dropped (not published for instance-group clusters); AWS/States metrics seen in account (dimension StateMachineArn; they count every execution in the window, and p15-b-spark-burst overlaps, so the AWS/States series are shared, not per run). LIMITATIONS known in advance: capacity flat by construction (maximum = minimum = 2); inputs are Phase 14 outputs made at build commit f159535e while the job runs at the new build commit (deviation 3); shuffle and task counts come from the job's own StageMetricsListener totals in _run_report.json (no Spark event log is read).
